text.p: Omniquip International Inc said Wednesday the underwriters of its initial public offering have exercised an over-allotment option to buy an additional 1.2 million shares of the company's common stock.
The shares will be purchased from Harbour Group Investments III LP and Uniquip-HGI Associates LP. The sale of these shares is expected to be completed on April 4.

Omniquip, a manufacturer of telescopic material handlers, made its IPO of eight million shares on March 20 at $14 per share through an underwriting group led by Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Credit Suisse First Boston Corp, Schroder Wertheim & Co Inc and Robert W. Baird & Co Inc.
The company sold three million shares and Harbour Group Investments III LP and Uniquip-HGI Associates LP, an affiliate of Harbour Group, sold a total five million shares.
As a result of the over-allotment exercise, Harbour Group will continue to own 4,150,000 shares, or about 29.2 percent of Omniquip's outstanding common.
